scene_description: A wide wooden drawer is partly open beneath a white counter. A black rectangular tray fills the middle, a blue Ziploc box is on the right, and a clear wrapper with white material and brown marks is on the left; a narrow wrapped item lies along the tray right side.

vlm_input.task_context: The robot will collect the black rectangular tray from the drawer and place it on the countertop for sorting. The Ziploc box and loose items must remain in the drawer.

guidance_specs.target_object: partly open wide wooden drawer with the central silver handle beneath the white counter
constraints: Pull the handle toward the camera while keeping the drawer on its runners

guidance_specs.context: Open the drawer farther to expose the pickup area above its contents.

guidance_specs.target_object: narrow clear-wrapped item resting along the right side of the black tray inside the drawer
constraints: Lift it clear of the tray rim

guidance_specs.context: Remove the loose wrapped item from the tray before its support is lifted.

review.problem: The counter covers much of the tray, and a separate wrapped item rests on it.
review.rationale: Expose the tray first, then set the loose item on independent support so the robot can collect only the tray.
